# `make_date`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Create date from year, month and day fields. If the configuration `spark.sql.ansi.enabled` is false, the function returns NULL on invalid inputs. Otherwise, it will throw an error instead.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
make_date(year, month, day)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 3 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- make_date, example 1
> SELECT make_date(2013, 7, 15);
2013-07-15
```

```sql
-- make_date, example 2
> SELECT make_date(2019, 7, NULL);
NULL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.0.0.
